horoscopes.horoscope: You are keenly interested in supernatural and occult phenomena, and today you will indulge in this hobby. You may buy a glossy hard-bound book on tantra or other paranormal things. However, Ganesha warns you to use the knowledge that you gain only for peaceful purposes. You will explore a different side of passion in yourself. Issues that you have been arguing over with your spouse may be sorted by evening. Listen to your sweetheart first and then indulge in lovemaking. As the day may be challenging from health point of view, so you should be careful in that your health is not affected. Avoid negative thinking today. You also need to avoid anger as it could affect your emotional balance, says Ganesha. Today is likely to be a very average day on the financial front for you. Since inflow of money is not going to be satisfactory, you must avoid taking any risks, advises Ganesha. You will stay cautious throughout the day in the office. You will also win appreciation from others. You need to abide by the schedule and should not push yourself too much or you may end up falling ill. Save your energy for the next battle.

All is not likely to go well during this day says Ganesha. Though you will sail smoothly most of the day, problems are very likely to come up. At the professional level you are not likely to face obstacles or difficulties. Your relations with your parents turn awkward and unpleasant. You could be getting into a serious argument with them and thereby displease and disappoint them. You need to respect their views and wishes and if necessary tender sincere apologies, if necessary. You may not like it if your partner tries to influence your thoughts and end up saying something that hurts him/her. Never forget to apologise your sweetheart if anything really goes wrong. You may not like to remain in touch with your beloved. The day will be very good for you. You will get happiness in personal life. You will get satisfaction in professional life. Your good work will get appreciated at office. This will inspire you to take up more work. You will get all round happiness. Today you are going to work at cross purposes as regards your own interests, especially in financial matters. You are quite conscious about your money, but Ganesha advises you not to flaunt it. If you are the leader of a team, you may focus on what your team members are doing today. There are chances that someone from your team tries to deceive you, so be alert. Control your temper else you may end up raising your voice.

You will be filled with concern and sensitivity towards others, and will bestow your blessings upon many. However, being too emotional is not advisable. Your emotions could get in the way of your progress at the work-front. You need to listen to your head over your heart when it comes to professional matters, says Ganesha. You may not give importance to your love life. You may remain detached from the relationship. Don’t let disagreements reign in your mind. Ignoring your love life for work will cost you more than you think. Take the help of your sweetheart and family members if things go wrong. There will be lot many activities in office. There will be complicated issues as well there. You will remain engrossed in solving them. You may be able to fix these problems using your analytical abilities. You might have to sit for extra time in office. You will need to be very diligent in order to increase your income. If you are in job, you may need to work for extra hours to increase your financial gains. Businesspersons need to do the same. It’s a day when you might remain as busy as a bee, says Ganesha. Complex issues might irritate you. You will have some big tasks to do. If you are a team leader, then you might have to give emotional support to your team members.

Today, you are likely to experience something life-changing. A small incident, an observation, a tragedy, a disaster, or a simple thought may change the course of your live. You, however, may not be able to take the changes well. It may have a strong bearing on your health. You may spend a lot of time with your loved ones, says Ganesha. This is an uneventful day, foresees Ganesha. You may spend the day with your sweetheart laying on the sofa discussing some interesting topics. You may start an activity and later may find it boring. A lazy yet comfortable day is on the cards. You will be physically fit today and enjoy good health. You will also find your professional life going well and may even get new projects. You will be completely positive. On the whole, it’s going to be a wonderful day for you. The day looks good for financial matters. Your past investments are likely to give you good returns today. If you have been taking interest in stock market of lately, this is going to be a good day. It will be a smooth day. You are fast, furiously efficient and almost flawless in your work. Your boss is likely to accept this fact. You may have to spend a lot of time browsing web pages in search of a crucial piece of information.

You need to keep your temper in check and guard against being aggressive today. You need to channelise your energies towards some productive pursuits, otherwise you may make someone the target of your anger. The good thing about the day is you will make satisfactory progress on work related issues. You may not find the rhythm in the relationship. Your partner may want you to be accountable for the home affairs whereas you are not likely to be happy with domestic responsibilities. Therefore, you should avoid conflicts on trivial issues that sour your relationship. The day will see, on hand renewing of old friendships. On the other hand, you will handle several issues which were long pending and were seeking your attention for quite some time. You should avoid arguing with your superiors, says Ganesha. Business plans shouldn’t be executed as planetary positions are unfavourable but at least you can work on ideas. This is the best day to work on property deals, as stars are in your favour for the same. It’s an average day for you, says Ganesha. Domestic issues may interfere with your work and you may feel the pressure, says Ganesha. At the office, you need to keep your nerve cool, suggests Ganesha. You may like to work alone or skip the tasks and simply pass the time.

You are renowned for your leadership qualities and today they will be much appreciated for the way you manage your team. You will get a long-due promotion, and will come in for some extra cash. Ganesha says you received all this by wisely balancing work and home, so be careful not to slip up on this front. Things may not look good at the beginning of the relationship. Your sweetheart does not seem to be convinced. You may not win in the matters related to the heart. However, you will benefit if you handle the matter intellectually. You are likely to manage your emotional stability later. It’s going to be a very good day for those who are into R&D. You will present your ideas in a very impacting manner in the meetings. All this is going to give you happiness and you will be in a good mood. You will have a clear idea about loopholes that you have in your financial handling. As a result to which, your financial management will improve to greater extent. You should be able to earn good money today. A good day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. The eagerness with which you will work today will help you finish your tasks quickly. You may learn a few trade secrets today. A hassle-free office will lead to an enjoyable evening at home.

Ganesha says today will be a wonderful day and bring forth a breakthrough for you. You shall get to know and learn a lot from top most officials and elderly people. The higher ups in your office will give you good support today. Ganesha warns you to stay away from judicial proceedings or pleadings, as today is not a good day for fighting court battles. There may be a clash of minds. Pay attention to your sweetheart. You should have a good control of your mind if things don’t work your way, suggests Ganesha. Things will be pretty good when you understand the emotional matters and take precautions. You will feel happy today because you will be rewarded for your hard work, says Ganesha. This will come in as a shot in arm for you. However, you will assigned even bigger responsibilities owing to your earlier bright performance. Health issues may led to expenses. It may vary from someone’s health to your own health issues, on which you may have to spend money. Hospitalization is the worst that can reduce your bank balance. Today, you will be driven by your subconscious mind. An interesting discussion with like-minded people is also on the cards. You may have to decide on an important decision post lunch. The majority of the pending works will be completed by the end of the evening.

Socially, you enjoy being in limelight as all the eyes are focused on you. However, beware of evil eyes that may not have good intentions towards you. You are a good soul and never hurt anyone. But, at times, it’s important to know your foe’s weakness to be on the safer side. Shopping with your partner is on the cards. You will select colour cosmetics and spruce yourself up for a long hour to seduce your loved one. Passion will drive you closer to your sweetheart and you seem to play a dominant role in lovemaking. You will work with lot of dedication and focus today. You will be very good at work today. However, you should keep in mind that you don’t get into a mood of settling scores with other people. You have to take care of that. Today you are going to operate exactly as per your basic nature when it comes to financial matters. Your financial decisions today will be based more on instincts, rather than any logical derivations. You are likely to grow slowly but steadily in the work front with your sheer determination and discipline. You seem to take responsibilities and pour all energies to achieve most of the tasks skillfully. You have the power to convince everyone in the team.

Scorpios beware. Tough time today is on the cards, and you may perhaps find your hands tied up in unpleasant money matters. But put in your best to overcome this situation and strive to be independent economically. The secret, says Ganesha, lies in diligence, optimism and tones of patience. Good thing is that you will be in a romantic mood and you may expect the same commitment from your soulmate. Your honesty and sincerity will attract your sweetheart. You may take some time to build the relationship but overall a harmonious night is on the cards. Ganesha feels, that it may be a hectic day at work and may affect your hralth due to stress. Be polite as there are chances of miss-communication with your office mates. Hence it’s better to keep a low profile today. Things on the financial front look bleak, feels Ganesha, and this is all because of your extravagant nature. You shall spend money like water. If you don’t control it, you will soon be in troubled waters. You wish to complete a certain project today itself, but it doesn’t seem to happen. Some adverse circumstances may come your way. However, you should not give up. Stick to your objectives, things will be fine in a few days, assures Ganesha.

You are beaming with optimism and positive energy. Such strong vibes will penetrate through the day and maintain the energy level right till the end. Not everyone is blessed with such spirit, so will certainly have an upper hand at work, be it your profession or business, says Ganesha. You will enjoy a smooth, peaceful and beautiful married life with your spouse, blesses Ganesha. Your sweetheart will be in a romantic mood and the day may turn out to be a perfect one as far as romance is concerned. You are likely to bring rhythm in life and want to make sure that your relationship goes smoothly, feels Ganesha. It’s a good day for you. However, you have to use tact today. As a team leader, you will be trying to solve problems of your team. But you should be careful while conveying your decisions. Also,you might be influenced by somebody else’s ideas. You need to maintain consistency in relations – then only they will remain financially or otherwise gainful to you. This would be a good lesson to be learned today as regards finances. The stars shine brightly in your luck. It’s time to hold important meetings at the workplace. Other’s views and ideas may hold importance. You are likely to be patient and make a decision after thinking pros and cons. You will focus more on quality of work rather than efficiency.

You are an excellent team player and your performance reaches a new high when you are a part of a group. Be an active member of your group, express your opinions, share your knowledge and see how your team becomes the winning team, says Ganesha. Wind up your day by hanging out with friends and family. You may plan to take some time out with your sweetheart. Family issues will also need your attention. You are not ready to pay attention to your partner’s point. Your lover may feel being ignored by you. Your partner may feel that you’re making life a bit complicated. It’s dangerous to take hasty judgments, that would be the underlying basis of your day today. You should think a lot before taking decisions, says Ganesha. It’s important to take that much care today. On the personal front, you may be too much into emotions. ‘More work means more money’ – this mantra will work in your favour as stars are showering their blessings on you today. Ganesha feels stars are indicating things are going to influence your finances positively. The day is all about how well you can manage stress. Career-related matters will be the topmost priority to you. You may also get a bit worried about your progress on the professional front. You may like to finish the pending tasks soon and want to shoulder more responsibilities.

Today you will feel like sharing you innermost feelings with those that you are close to. You will find yourself communicating better and this will result in attracting intellectual people towards you. You will get an opportunity to work with very educated and well established people. This will result in personal progress at work, says Ganesha. Your emotions for your partner may be overwhelmingly high. Passion runs deep inside may be due to your partner’s look, or attire. You are not in a mood to talk but to indulge in making love till the night gets over, feels Ganesha. Jealousy is going to affect you today, says Ganesha. You will feel frustrated due to this factor. You will not be perturbed by your rival’s success but by your own failure. You need better bonding with the people around you to lessen your frustration. Accumulation of money and saving both will matter a lot to you, thus you will have strong drive for finances today. This factor will surely work in your favour and will add conviction in business or work. You are likely to be in a mood to speculate with an intention to earn fast cash. You will reap good rewards for your hard work. You may get appreciation from your colleagues and your honesty will pay off in the long run.
